title: Joint Sample Assembly Worktable and Tool Rack
description: One static carpentry assembly-preparation scene from the original woodworking scene program. One complete original open worktable supports one whole fixed half-inserted mortise-and-tenon sample kit and one whole open-mouth hand plane. A separate complete original freestanding tool rack behind the table retains its original hammer, wooden mallet and single chisel; none is extracted or counted anew. All four whole old asset IDs preserve original local POSITION/NORMAL bytes, complete PBR materials and internal hierarchy. Only unit-scale whole translations and a finite new floor are authored. The complete sample and plane footprints lie on the actual finite table top, their soles meet its height and their bounds are separated; whole rack and table floor footprints fit on the floor with a positive station gap. This is not the old two-sawhorse/plank/handsaw scene renamed, and it creates zero new independent tools or joint variants. Static display only: no assembly motion, clamping, cutting, wood removal, worker, force, universal joint fit, load or workshop safety assertion.
